title: What do you MEME? Generating Explanations for Visual Semantic Role Labelling in Memes
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focuses on generating natural language explanations for semantic roles (hero, villain, victim) assigned to entities within memes related to US Politics and COVID-19.
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study. The only mention is in the related work section, which cites a paper on detecting anti-semitism.
